title: Fix the theme render defects the audit found: Bold hero clipping at 390 and Designer services overlapping at 390 (Default sections drawing bare was a harness artifact, pinned by a test)

source.ref: Theme cohesion sweep (docs/THEME-COHESION.md, ADR-1923). Owner picks 2026-10-29: role blocks and manifest, phased; no live site changes on its own.

detail:
Reproduce each in a built site first; the Default result may be a harness artifact. Render test per defect.

Bold Hero headline clamps under 640px; Designer services columns collapse at 900/560 (inline --dz-cols beat the media rule, now --dz-cols-wide); Default sections bare was a harness artifact (sheet is scoped to the chrome's data-house-site root, pinned by test). Render test per defect. Showcase ignoring the theme is not fixed here: ShowcaseBlock is ink-only by design (bg-slat, on-ink in components/page-editor/blocks/collections.tsx); the role blocks (LIVE-1858, LIVE-1859) are where a block takes a ground from the theme.

verify.note: Reads the wiring this row ships; fails on main. The behaviour is pinned by the row's own tests.
